item.title: How to Start a Homelab: Hardware, Hypervisor, and Your First Service
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A homelab is your own small infrastructure for experiments and self-hosted services. A first-homelab checklist covering hardware, hypervisor, your first service, backups, and security - plus what my homelab looks like and where to go next.
